rules.title: ch / tch and j / dge after vowels
rules.short_explanation: After a short vowel, use -tch for the /ch/ sound (watch, catch) and -dge for the /j/ sound (bridge, badge). After a long vowel or a consonant, use -ch and -ge: beach, teach, age, large.
rules.tts_text: After a short vowel use tch and dge. Otherwise use ch and ge.
rules.mnemonic: Short vowel, strong ending: tch and dge.

examples.text: Please watch the luggage while I pay.
He wants to catch the early train.
The bridge over the river is old.
We ate lunch on the beach.
I cook dinner in a tiny kitchen.
The teacher will teach us new words.
What is the age limit for this course?
The judge listened to both sides.
She wore a badge with her name.
The hotel room has a huge window.
We watched a tennis match on Sunday.
We wachted the football game together.
examples.correction: We watched the football game together.

examples.text: The dog tried to cach the ball.
examples.correction: The dog tried to catch the ball.

examples.text: They walked over the bridg after lunch.
examples.correction: They walked over the bridge after lunch.

examples.text: She works in a small kichen at home.
examples.correction: She works in a small kitchen at home.

examples.text: The techer explained the exercise again.
examples.correction: The teacher explained the exercise again.

examples.text: What is the ag limit for the course?
examples.correction: What is the age limit for the course?

examples.text: The judg gave a clear answer.
examples.correction: The judge gave a clear answer.

examples.text: He showed me his name badg.
examples.correction: He showed me his name badge.

examples.text: The room has a hug window.
examples.correction: The room has a huge window.

examples.text: We watched a tennis mach on Sunday.
examples.correction: We watched a tennis match on Sunday.

examples.text: We had a picnic on the bech.
examples.correction: We had a picnic on the beach.

examples.text: We have much to do today.
examples.note: Short vowel u, but much ends in ch, not tch.

examples.text: It was such a nice day.
examples.note: Short vowel u, but such ends in ch, not tch.

examples.text: Which bus goes to the airport?
examples.note: Short vowel i, but which ends in ch, not tch.
